name: Scratch milling PCBs with a vinyl cutter/plotter

mentions.name: Scratch milling PCBs with a vinyl cutter/plotter
mentions.description: This DIY project makes PCBs at home by scratch milling single-layer copper board with a vinyl cutter/plotter and an engraving bit. Instead of a CNC, the approach relies on regulating pressure, which the author found more important than depth; work is currently focused on dialing in pressure, speed, and the number of passes.
mentions.problem: Making PCBs at home without a CNC, by finding the right pressure, speed, and number of passes for engraving copper board with a vinyl cutter/plotter.
